description: Set up or change the user's ATTIM profile: one public link-in-bio page at <handle>.attim.link with their name, bio, avatar, social icons, up to 2 pinned links, other links, and their own sites under Projects. Call get_public_profile first. To set one up, ask for their name, a short bio, an optional https avatar URL, the links, and the handle they want (free on every plan). When changing, omitted fields stay; socials, theme, links, and projects replace what is stored, so pass link ids to keep click history. A new handle changes the address (Free: once a week; the old one redirects for 30 days).

avatarUrl.description: https image URL; null removes it.

id.description: Existing link id; keeps its click history.

name.description: Display name. Needed to set one up.

projects.description: The user's own sites to show, in order.

label.description: Shown instead of the site title.

searchIndexing.description: Set up only: listed by search engines (default true).

socials.description: Icons under the bio; email takes an email address.

theme.description: A preset plus optional overrides. Colors are #rrggbb.

name: save_profile
title: Save profile
